Test Name: Access Email Templates Management Page
Precondition: Administrator is logged in and has permission to manage email templates.
Steps: 1. Navigate to Admin > Email Templates.
Expected Result:
- Email Templates management page is displayed
- Existing templates list/grid is displayed
- Actions for Create/Edit/Delete/Copy and Enable/Disable are available

Test Name: Open Create Email Template Form
Precondition: Administrator is on Email Templates management page.
Steps: 1. Click Create New Template.
Expected Result: - Template creation form is displayed

Test Name: Create Template (All Users) with Trigger + Subject + Body
Precondition: Administrator is on the Create Template form.
Steps:
1. Enter a template name (unique).
2. Set Role to All users.
3. Set Trigger Type to submission created.
4. Enter Subject content.
5. Enter Body content.
6. Click Save/Submit.
Expected Result:
- Template can be configured for role, trigger, subject, body
- Template is saved when submitted
- New template appears in the templates list with correct values

Test Name: Create Template (Submitters) and Persist Role Selection
Precondition: Administrator is on the Create Template form.
Steps:
1. Enter a template name (unique).
2. Set Role to Submitters.
3. Select any Trigger Type.
4. Enter Subject and Body.
5. Save.
Expected Result:
- Template is saved
- Saved template shows Role = Submitters

Test Name: Create Template (Reviewers) and Persist Role Selection
Precondition: Administrator is on the Create Template form.
Steps:
1. Enter a template name (unique).
2. Set Role to Reviewers.
3. Select any Trigger Type.
4. Enter Subject and Body.
5. Save.
Expected Result:
- Template is saved
- Saved template shows Role = Reviewers

Test Name: Create Template (Committee Members) and Persist Role Selection
Precondition: Administrator is on the Create Template form.
Steps:
1. Enter a template name (unique).
2. Set Role to Committee members.
3. Select any Trigger Type.
4. Enter Subject and Body.
5. Save.
Expected Result:
- Template is saved
- Saved template shows Role = Committee members

Test Name: Trigger Types List Contains Required Values and Others
Precondition: Administrator is on Create or Edit Template form.
Steps:
1. Open Trigger Type control (dropdown/list).
2. Inspect available trigger types.
Expected Result:
- Trigger types include: submission created
- Trigger types include: submission reviewed
- Trigger types include: submission accepted
- Other trigger types are available in the list

Test Name: Save Template and Verify Subject/Body Persistence
Precondition: Administrator is on the Create Template form.
Steps:
1. Enter Subject content with distinctive text.
2. Enter Body content with distinctive text.
3. Save the template.
4. Re-open the template in Edit mode.
Expected Result:
- Subject and body are saved with the template
- Subject and body fields are populated with the saved content

Test Name: Open Edit Template Form and Verify Data Is Populated
Precondition: At least one email template exists.
Steps:
1. From the templates list, select a template.
2. Click Edit.
Expected Result:
- Template edit form is displayed
- Form is populated with existing template data (role, trigger, subject, body, enabled/disabled status)

Test Name: Edit Template Subject and Body and Save Changes
Precondition: An email template exists and is opened in Edit mode.
Steps:
1. Update Subject content.
2. Update Body content.
3. Click Save/Submit.
Expected Result:
- Changes are saved when submitted
- Updated template is reflected in the templates list and when re-opening the template

Test Name: Edit Template Role and Save Changes
Precondition: An email template exists and is opened in Edit mode.
Steps:
1. Change Role (e.g., from All users to Reviewers).
2. Save.
Expected Result:
- Role change is saved
- Updated role is reflected in the templates list and on re-open

Test Name: Edit Template Trigger Type and Save Changes
Precondition: An email template exists and is opened in Edit mode.
Steps:
1. Change Trigger Type (e.g., submission created -> submission accepted).
2. Save.
Expected Result:
- Trigger type change is saved
- Updated trigger type is reflected in the templates list and on re-open

Test Name: Disable an Enabled Template and Persist Status
Precondition: At least one template exists and is currently Enabled.
Steps:
1. From the templates list, disable the template (toggle/checkbox/action).
2. Refresh the page or navigate away and back.
Expected Result:
- Template can be disabled
- Enabled/disabled status is saved and persists after refresh
- Template shows status = Disabled

Test Name: Enable a Disabled Template and Persist Status
Precondition: At least one template exists and is currently Disabled.
Steps:
1. From the templates list, enable the template (toggle/checkbox/action).
2. Refresh the page or navigate away and back.
Expected Result:
- Template can be enabled
- Enabled/disabled status is saved and persists after refresh
- Template shows status = Enabled

Test Name: Delete Template Shows Confirmation Dialog
Precondition: At least one email template exists.
Steps: 1. In templates list, click Delete on a template.
Expected Result: - Deletion confirmation is shown

Test Name: Cancel Delete Does Not Remove Template
Precondition: Deletion confirmation dialog is displayed for a selected template.
Steps: 1. Click Cancel/No/Close on the confirmation dialog.
Expected Result:
- Template is not removed
- Template remains visible in the templates list

Test Name: Confirm Delete Removes Template
Precondition: Deletion confirmation dialog is displayed for a selected template.
Steps: 1. Click Confirm/Yes/Delete on the confirmation dialog.
Expected Result:
- Template is removed after confirmation
- Template no longer appears in the templates list

Test Name: Copy Template Shows Confirmation Dialog
Precondition: At least one email template exists.
Steps: 1. In templates list, click Copy on a template.
Expected Result: - Copy confirmation is shown

Test Name: Cancel Copy Does Not Create New Template
Precondition: Copy confirmation dialog is displayed for a selected template.
Steps: 1. Click Cancel/No/Close on the confirmation dialog.
Expected Result:
- No new template is created
- Templates count remains unchanged

Test Name: Confirm Copy Creates New Template with Same Config
Precondition: Copy confirmation dialog is displayed for a selected template.
Steps: 1. Click Confirm/Yes/Copy on the confirmation dialog.
Expected Result:
- Template is copied after confirmation
- A new template appears in the list
- Copied template retains role, trigger, subject, and body from the original (unless product defines otherwise)

Test Name: Automated Notification Uses Enabled Template (Submission Created)
Precondition: An enabled template exists with Trigger Type = submission created. Workflow event engine/email delivery is available.
Steps:
1. Ensure the template is Enabled.
2. Cause workflow event: create a submission.
3. Observe notification delivery (email outbox/logs/inbox depending on environment).
Expected Result:
- Notification is sent automatically when event occurs
- Appropriate template is selected based on trigger (submission created)
- Delivered email subject/body match the configured template content

Test Name: Automated Notification Selects Template by Trigger (Submission Reviewed)
Precondition: Enabled templates exist for submission created and submission reviewed. Workflow event engine/email delivery is available.
Steps:
1. Ensure template for Trigger Type = submission reviewed is Enabled.
2. Cause workflow event: review a submission.
3. Observe notification delivery.
Expected Result:
- Notification is sent automatically
- Template selected corresponds to trigger = submission reviewed (not the submission created template)

Test Name: Automated Notification Selects Template by Trigger (Submission Accepted)
Precondition: An enabled template exists for Trigger Type = submission accepted. Workflow event engine/email delivery is available.
Steps:
1. Ensure template for Trigger Type = submission accepted is Enabled.
2. Cause workflow event: accept a submission.
3. Observe notification delivery.
Expected Result:
- Notification is sent automatically
- Template selected corresponds to trigger = submission accepted

Test Name: Disabled Template Is Not Used for Notifications
Precondition: A template exists for a trigger (e.g., submission created) and is set to Disabled. Workflow event engine/email delivery is available.
Steps:
1. Disable the template for submission created.
2. Cause workflow event: create a submission.
3. Observe notification delivery.
Expected Result:
- Only enabled templates are used
- Disabled template is not selected for sending (system uses another enabled template for that trigger if configured; otherwise no email is sent)

Test Name: Role-Based Recipients - Submitters Template Sends to Submitter
Precondition: An enabled template exists with Role = Submitters and a supported trigger (e.g., submission created). A submitter user can create submissions.
Steps:
1. Ensure the Submitters template is Enabled.
2. As a submitter, create a submission.
3. Observe recipients of the sent notification.
Expected Result:
- Notification is sent to Submitter audience for the event context
- Non-submitter roles do not receive this notification (as applicable)

Test Name: Role-Based Recipients - Reviewers Template Sends to Reviewers
Precondition: An enabled template exists with Role = Reviewers and a supported trigger (e.g., submission reviewed). Reviewers exist for the submission/workflow.
Steps:
1. Ensure the Reviewers template is Enabled.
2. Cause workflow event that should notify reviewers.
3. Observe recipients of the sent notification.
Expected Result:
- Notification is sent to Reviewer audience for the event context
- Users outside Reviewer audience do not receive this notification (as applicable)

Test Name: Role-Based Recipients - Committee Template Sends to Committee Members
Precondition: An enabled template exists with Role = Committee members and a supported trigger. Committee members exist for the submission/workflow.
Steps:
1. Ensure the Committee members template is Enabled.
2. Cause workflow event that should notify committee members.
3. Observe recipients of the sent notification.
Expected Result:
- Notification is sent to Committee member audience for the event context
- Users outside Committee audience do not receive this notification (as applicable)
